annotations.title: Open a project in Summer Engine

description: Open a project in Summer Engine. Waits until it connects; installs the engine only with install: true (the person's yes). Next: summer_get_project_context.

install.description: Install Summer Engine first when it is missing. Set true only after the person said yes.

path.description: The project folder (holds project.godot), e.g. projectPath from summer_projects_create_local. Default this session's project.
